correctness.rationale: For all n>=1, each unary type is one of 2n antipodal-boundary arcs. Directed 3cycle requires three angular gaps below pi; separate arc-edge feasibility gives index gaps <=n. With distinct arcs, at most one index gap equals n and can be shrunk; with two equal arcs the third must be antipodal; three equal arcs force transitivity. Cyclic compositions give n(n-1)(n+4) distinct-index profiles plus 6n two-equal profiles. An independent finite exact-rational geometry checker reproduced n(n+1)(n+2) for n=1..8; finite tests do not prove the general case.

value.rationale: Sharp three-type local-to-global lifting identifies the exact exceptional configuration, a natural amalgamation question that cannot be answered by unary type counts or integer Smith factors. The cubic law gives the complete directed-triangle support count for any named base size, independent of its induced orientation; the exact count is a useful invariant for higher-arity orbital extensions. The theorem is not merely a reparameterization of the known binary matrix SNF.
